Name: Slightly Older Harvey (CP)
Author: kultmania
Description:
makes harvey look a little older, with more of a "dad bod' + adds a mustache to his sprites. also adds custom aerobics portraits/sprites and edits that event a tiny bit (on account of i don't know how to make a custom walk cycle and it was easier to just rewrite it).

my first time making pixel art or a mod, go easy on me! 

has two versions: one with small dialogue edits and one without. i just changed the references to his crush on maru, and fixed a few lines i thought were awkward.

unsure if it conflicts with other dialogue mods, so it's probably best to use the version with no dialogue edits if you're using in tandem with a dialogue expansion/edit mod, but feel free to let me know your experience.

inspiration:

big thanks in particular to thebigjb + airyn for being so kind and helpful, and for making such great mods! please check everyone out + support their work!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23094]Handsomer Harvey[/url] by TheBigJB (referenced for sprites to get an idea of how to elongate the face and add a mustache)
[url=https://devcrap.tumblr.com]devcrap[/url] (BIG influence on my harv headcanon's in general)
[url=https://www.tumblr.com/doctor-aceus-art]doctor-aceus[/url]
[url=https://rute-me.tumblr.com/]Rute_me[/url]
[url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]airyn (diverse stardew valley)[/url] (referenced the technique for drawing his chest hair in beach portraits)
